source.note: single-card witness of the SOUGHT hole 'prevention' (topology-scaffold holes: priority 3, kind BEHAVIOR, slang ['fog'], note 'a shield/replacement on the damage event', proposed_stem modification:prevention). No declared stem existed — this witness CREATES it, so the rollup flags it unpredicted:true (the backlog burn-down, not an error). Oracle (whole card): 'Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn.' A single spell ability whose sole effect is the prevention shield, so the emit is THE witness with no incidental context. AST faithful, not a wish (hand-parsed gold Fixtures/HandParsedCards/Fog.json): Ability.Kind=spell, one Effect EffectType=preventDamage { All=true, CombatOnly=true, Duration=untilTime(Turn/End) }. ADR-3 canonical: side=emit, kind=BEHAVIOR (a prevention shield is a continuous effect — CR 611/615 — living in the 'modification' supergroup = 'an object/event altered in place'), stem=modification:prevention (the hole's proposed_stem). Live engine projects the ADR-2 coarse label preventDamage (known-coarse-projections.json: 'baseline coarse fallback — no flow rule consumes it yet' — shadow-mode inert per ACCRETION; NOT emit:unparsed, the parser derives the effect richly). duration=eot is AST-derivable (Duration End-of-Turn) and LICENSED (duration axis licensed_by modification:*, enum contains eot), so this gold also first-witnesses the duration axis on a non-creature modification stem. MISSING-AXIS SURFACED, NOT INVENTED: the hole's proposed attr 'prevents=combat-damage' has no closed axis. CombatOnly=true is the prevented-damage class (combat/noncombat/all); it maps semantically to the existing 'combat' axis (enum [combat,noncombat,any]) but that axis is licensed_by [damage-dealt, combat-presence], NOT modification:*, so it is not licensed for modification:prevention. Following the boggart-brute precedent (bare modification:evasion witnessed, evasion-kind axis surfaced not invented), this gold witnesses the bare stem carrying only the licensed duration facet and DOES NOT attach an unlicensed combat facet or invent a 'prevents' key. Scaffold decision surfaced: extend the 'combat' axis licensed_by to include modification:prevention (or modification:*), or add a new prevented-damage-class axis. a prevention shield is a continuous effect (PreventDamageEffect : ContinuousEffect; CR 611/615) — a time-varying property watching the damage event, not a discrete occurrence; belongs to the modification supergroup.

PreventDamageEffect.Duration = untilTime(Turn/End) — 'this turn'. duration axis enum contains eot and is licensed_by modification:*, which covers modification:prevention; this gold first-witnesses the duration axis on a modification:prevention stem.

CombatOnly=true (only combat damage is prevented; CR 510.2) is the prevented-damage class, but neither a stem leaf nor a licensed closed axis captures it — the 'combat' axis (enum combat/noncombat/any) is licensed_by [damage-dealt, combat-presence], not modification:*. Recorded in source.note as an open scaffold question (extend combat's licensing or add a prevented-damage-class axis), not invented as an ad-hoc attrs key.
